metadata.title: Share, discover and build.
metadata.description: Share your ideas, discover opportunities and build projects with a community that validates, not just comments.

hero.title: Turn your idea into a validated project
hero.description: An independent platform to publish ideas, get structured feedback, validate projects and find like-minded collaborators.

features.title: Everything you need to validate your idea
features.subtitle: From structured publishing to connecting with other entrepreneurs, the portal supports you at every stage.

items.title: Publish your idea
items.description: Describe your proposal with structure: problem, solution, target market and stage of development.

items.title: Get real feedback
items.description: The community comments with defined criteria so you can improve your project with concrete input.

items.title: Find collaborators
items.description: Connect with profiles that complement your skills and build teams to move forward together.

how.title: From idea to project in three steps
how.subtitle: A simple process that gives you clarity and connects you with the right people.

steps.title: Publish
steps.description: Share your idea with a guided format: explain the problem, your solution and the market you are targeting.

steps.title: Get feedback
steps.description: The community and mentors comment with objective criteria so you can improve iteratively.

steps.title: Validate and grow
steps.description: Find collaborators, join communities and prepare your project for the next level.

community.title: You don't have to go it alone
community.description: Join an active community of entrepreneurs who share your concerns. Take part in discussions, get honest feedback and build teams with people who complement your skills.
points: Connection with profiles related to your project
Themed communities by industry and stage
community.ctaText: Create your free account and start building your project with the support of a community that validates, not just comments.
